caption: The drawing depicts a brass door knocker mounted on a rectangular, vertically-oriented piece of brown wood. The door knocker features an ornate design, with a round, convex central plate, and an attached handle that curves outward, ending in a spherical knob. The handle is attached with two screws and pivots on metal arms that are equally decorative, with scroll-like patterns. Beneath the main handle, there is a detailed lattice-like brass plate affixed to the wood, serving as the base where the handle would strike. The wood has visible vertical grain and appears weathered with darker and lighter brown hues throughout. The brass of the knocker itself is rendered in shades of gold, brown, and green, showing areas where the metal has aged or tarnished. The image has a plain, off-white background, and there is a small signature reading "L. B. HARTMANN" in the lower right corner.
title: Street Car Bell
